text: Thiago Silva Morato is a software engineer with more than four years of professional experience, primarily focused on frontend engineering with React, Angular, and TypeScript.
Thiago is expanding his backend and software architecture knowledge with the goal of becoming a stronger full-stack engineer.
Thiago approaches software engineering with a focus on solving problems, creating scalable solutions, and delivering meaningful value to customers.
Thiago's native language is Portuguese (Brazil) and he has advanced/fluent proficiency in English, able to work, write and communicate professionally in English.
Thiago has worked as a software engineer at Dart Digital in Ribeirão Preto, São Paulo, since June 2022.
Working at a software house exposed Thiago to different teams, clients, products, and technical contexts.
Thiago progressed from Junior Developer to Mid-level Developer during his professional career.
At Dart Digital, Thiago has professional experience building product features with GraphQL (including Apollo) on the API layer and Tailwind CSS for styling, alongside React, Angular and TypeScript.
At Dart Digital, Thiago contributed to a SaaS platform for external clients, helping deliver its first production-ready version and supporting the onboarding of the product's first paying customer.

Thiago led the redesign of an evaluation-cycle tracking flow at Dart Digital, consolidating six fragmented listing pages into a single performance-oriented interface that improved usability and simplified monitoring for users.
Thiago implemented an authentication flow with invisible (silent) reCAPTCHA at Dart Digital, strengthening security without adding friction to the user login experience.

At Dart Digital, Thiago took ownership of feature design, architectural decisions, frontend performance optimizations and code reviews, contributing to the team's technical quality and consistency. He works remotely with a distributed Agile team.
React is Thiago's primary frontend technology and one of the main technologies in his professional development experience.
Thiago has significant professional experience with Angular and has used it extensively in frontend application development.
TypeScript is one of Thiago's main programming languages and is used extensively in his frontend development work.
Thiago has specialized professionally in JavaScript and TypeScript.
Node.js is Thiago's primary backend technology and the main focus of his backend development learning and experience.
Thiago has studied and developed backend applications using Node.js frameworks and technologies including NestJS, Express.js, and Fastify.
Thiago has studied .NET Core as part of his effort to expand his backend development knowledge, but Node.js is his primary backend technology.
Thiago has experience with micro frontend architecture and has been expanding his knowledge of software architecture.
Thiago has experience with Styled Components, Sass, Tailwind CSS, and plain CSS for frontend styling.
Thiago has professional experience using Material UI to build React interfaces and reusable UI components.
Thiago has experience using shadcn/ui to build modern and reusable React interfaces.
Thiago has professional experience with GraphQL and Apollo for building and consuming APIs.
Thiago works with Next.js to build React applications.
Thiago has experience with frontend state management and forms using Redux and React Hook Form.
Thiago has worked with SQL relational databases and with MongoDB.
Thiago has experience with automated testing and quality practices, including Jest, Vitest and Supertest, as well as TDD and BDD.
Thiago uses Git and GitHub for version control and has experience with Docker, Webpack and Jira.
Thiago is comfortable investigating technical problems and implementing solutions designed to be scalable and maintainable.
Thiago considers user experience an important part of frontend engineering and aims to build responsive and easy-to-use interfaces.
Thiago has experience integrating frontend applications with backend APIs and handling asynchronous application data.
Thiago has implemented dynamic forms and selection interfaces in Angular applications based on data returned by backend endpoints.
Thiago has worked with complex frontend data tables involving pagination, filtering, row selection, and API-driven data.
Thiago faced a frontend issue where selecting a row in a data table caused the selection state to reset because API-driven rerenders were recreating the table state.
Thiago addressed the table selection problem by controlling the selection state explicitly instead of relying entirely on the table's internal state.
Thiago implemented table behavior where only one checkbox could remain selected at a time, providing radio-button-like behavior while working with a checkbox-based interface.
Thiago investigated a production-environment issue where PDFs generated with jsPDF worked locally but were blank in the homologation environment.
Thiago investigated the blank PDF issue by analyzing environment differences and browser console errors related to insecure resource loading.
Thiago worked on an issue involving a Material UI Autocomplete inside a modal where typing caused focus problems and unexpected modal behavior.
Thiago has implemented frontend functionality for selecting and uploading Excel files to backend endpoints.
Thiago values collaboration and prefers to work together with the team when making technical and product decisions.
When Thiago disagrees with a technical or product decision, he prefers to discuss the reasoning with the team and work toward a better solution.
Thiago is more concerned with achieving the best outcome for the customer than with proving that his own idea is correct.
Thiago evaluates technical decisions based on their potential value and impact on the delivered product rather than personal preference.
Thiago developed adaptability by working with different teams, clients, projects, and technologies.
Thiago considers fast learning an important professional skill and actively expands his knowledge into backend development, architecture, and artificial intelligence.
Thiago has professional experience working with Scrum and agile software development practices.
Thiago is pursuing a postgraduate degree focused on Applied AI Engineering.
Thiago has been expanding his backend development and software architecture knowledge as part of his transition toward full-stack engineering.
Thiago completed a Bachelor's degree at São Luís, in Jaboticabal, São Paulo, between January 2022 and January 2025.
Thiago completed a postgraduate program (Pós Tech Developer 360) at Faculdade de Tecnologia Rocketseat, from January 2025 to January 2026.

Thiago holds several certifications, most of them from Rocketseat: Ignite Node, Trilha Ignite React 2021, Trilha Ignite Node 2021, NLW AI, NLW Together and NLW Journey C#. He also completed an HTML/CSS/JavaScript/ReactJS course at Newtab Academy and a React course at Origamid.
Thiago's portfolio includes an AI chatbot that uses a RAG-oriented knowledge base to provide additional information about his professional profile.
Thiago can be contacted by email at thiagosmorato@gmail.com.
Thiago's LinkedIn profile is available at https://www.linkedin.com/in/thiago-silva-morato/.
Thiago works in Ribeirão Preto, São Paulo, Brazil.
